    Profile

    Alaia is an apprentice with a musical band in Envylia. Her talent for music isn't that exceptional, but when humming to herself during leisure time, people have told her there's something magical in her melodies. This has earned her the group's respect.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Female
    Height: 145cm
    Weight: 39kg
    Birthday: Mar 25
    Blood Type: Type Ki
    Zodiac: Moon of the Water Guardian
    Likes: Peaches
    Hobbies: Leisurely humming
    Illust: はねこと
    CV: 大和田仁美
